description: NOAA R/S/G storm-scale snapshot: latest observations, rolling 24-hour observed maxima, and the 3-day forecast. Includes latest Kp, its G-scale equivalent, aurora-visibility latitude, and a plain-language summary. Request the optional SWPC Forecast Discussion for context. For details, use noaa_spaceweather_get_solar_wind, noaa_spaceweather_get_aurora_forecast, or noaa_spaceweather_get_alerts.

include_discussion.description: Also fetch SWPC's forecaster-written Forecast Discussion, which explains why the forecast looks the way it does (CME versus coronal-hole stream, expected arrival). Costs one extra upstream request.

name: noaa_spaceweather_get_conditions

auroraLatitude.description: Aurora guidance for currentKp, e.g. "Aurora possible to ~55° geomagnetic latitude".

anyOf.description: SWPC forecaster's narrative behind the scales.

issued.description: ISO 8601 UTC issue time from the ":Issued:" line; null when absent.

forecast.description: Next-3-day forecast text; null when the section has none.

summary.description: Past-24 h summary text; null when the section has none.

discussion.description: SWPC Forecast Discussion; null unless include_discussion is true.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `feed_unavailable`: SWPC feed returns 5xx or 429, times out, or answers with a body that is not parseable JSON. Retried for up to 45 seconds in total before failing. `feed_moved`: SWPC feed returns a permanent 4xx, the scales feed lacks its latest observed period (key "0") or carries a malformed required scale field, or the forecast discussion has no topic section. Fails in one attempt. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

forecast.description: 3-day scale forecast, oldest first; starts with today (the date of observedAt).

G.description: Forecast G level, or all null fields when unissued.

label.description: Label, e.g. "G2", or null when SWPC issued no level.

scale.description: Whole-number level 0–5, or null when unissued.

text.description: Descriptor, or null when SWPC issued no level.

R.description: R outlook: a level, probabilities, or neither.

label.description: Label, e.g. "R1"; null when no level was issued.

majorProbPercent.description: Chance (%) of an R3+ blackout this day; null when none issued.

minorProbPercent.description: Chance (%) of an R1–R2 blackout this day; null when none issued.

scale.description: R level 0–5; null when SWPC issued a probability, not a level.

text.description: R descriptor; null when no level was issued.

S.description: S outlook: a level, a probability, or neither.

label.description: Label, e.g. "S1"; null when no level was issued.

probPercent.description: Chance (%) of an S1+ radiation storm this day; null when none issued.

scale.description: S level 0–5; null when SWPC issued a probability, not a level.

text.description: S descriptor; null when no level was issued.

observedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC stamp for the latest scales period, e.g. "2026-06-04T15:00:00Z".

summary.description: Plain-language status, e.g. "G2 moderate geomagnetic storm in progress."

G.description: Latest observed G level, or all null fields when unissued.

label.description: Label, e.g. "G2", or null when SWPC issued no level.

scale.description: Whole-number level 0–5, or null when unissued.

text.description: Descriptor, or null when SWPC issued no level.

R.description: Latest observed R level, or all null fields when unissued.

label.description: Label, e.g. "G2", or null when SWPC issued no level.

scale.description: Whole-number level 0–5, or null when unissued.

text.description: Descriptor, or null when SWPC issued no level.

S.description: Latest observed S level, or all null fields when unissued.

label.description: Label, e.g. "G2", or null when SWPC issued no level.

scale.description: Whole-number level 0–5, or null when unissued.

text.description: Descriptor, or null when SWPC issued no level.

G.description: Maximum observed G level over the past 24 hours.

R.description: Maximum observed R level over the past 24 hours.

S.description: Maximum observed S level over the past 24 hours.

yesterday.description: R/S/G rolling 24-hour observed maxima with their SWPC date stamp. Null when the period or a level is unavailable.

title: Get Space Weather Conditions
